text: A dawn grazer that carries the old forest song in its antlers. Brush adults for Dawn Velvet.
Dawn Stags graze in Overworld forests, and in the March on the Steppe, in the Highlands and in the Reed Fen. They spawn on open, well-lit ground.
A stag has **24 health** and **1 armour**. It is gentle: it runs when hurt and keeps away from monsters. Breed two with **wheat**.
pages.title: Where you find it

text: Brush an adult for **Dawn Velvet**, once a minute. Velvet binds into 2 Spiritweave under Water.

If you hunt one, it drops **1 to 3 Raw Game** and **0 to 2 March Leather**; Looting adds up to one more of each, and a stag that dies burning drops its meat already cooked. See [Game and leather](game_and_leather).
pages.title: What it gives

text: Bond an adult with a Bonding Charm and it becomes a mount that needs no saddle. Use it to climb on, steer with your gaze, hold jump for a short leap and sneak to get off.
It carries only the one it is bonded to. A stag with a strong Stride thread runs faster, and the rare **Leap** mark jumps higher. More on the [familiar gifts](familiar_gifts) page.
